definitions.explanation: A solid piece of debris from an asteroid or comet that survives passage through the atmosphere and lands on Earth's surface.

examples.japanese: ⟦{博物館|はくぶつかん}→博物館：01494_hakubutsukan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{隕石|いんせき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}た→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: I saw a meteorite at the museum.

examples.japanese: {隕石|いんせき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{分析|ぶんせき}→分析：03610_bunseki⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{太陽系|たいようけい}→太陽系：12216_taiyoukei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{歴史|れきし}→歴史：02267_rekishi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦わかる→わかる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: Analysis of meteorites reveals the history of the solar system.

examples.japanese: {隕石|いんせき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{畑|はたけ}→畑：00842_hatake⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{落|お}ちている→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{農家|のうか}→農家：03539_nouka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発見|はっけん}した→発見する：00085_hakken⟧。
examples.english: A farmer found a meteorite that had fallen in the field.

notes:
{隕石|いんせき} refers to a meteorite. {隕|いん} means 'fall from the sky' and {石|せき} means 'stone.'

METEOR TERMINOLOGY:
- ⟦{流星|りゅうせい}→流星：06310_ryuusei⟧: meteor (streak of light)
- ⟦{流|なが}れ{星|ぼし}→流れ星：05049_nagareboshi⟧: shooting star (casual)
- {隕石|いんせき}: meteorite (rock that reaches ground)
- ⟦{隕鉄|いんてつ}→隕鉄：noentry⟧: iron meteorite

TYPES:
- ⟦{石質|せきしつ}→石質：noentry⟧{隕石|いんせき}: stony meteorite
- ⟦{鉄|てつ}→鉄：02225_tetsu⟧{隕石|いんせき}: iron meteorite
- ⟦{石鉄|せきてつ}→石鉄：noentry⟧{隕石|いんせき}: stony-iron meteorite

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {隕石|いんせき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{落|お}ちる→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧: a meteorite falls
- {隕石|いんせき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{拾|ひろ}う→拾う：00845_hirou⟧: to find/pick up a meteorite
- {隕石|いんせき}⟦クレーター→クレーター：noentry⟧: meteorite crater
- {隕石|いんせき}⟦{衝突|しょうとつ}→衝突：03235_shoutotsu⟧: meteorite impact

SCIENTIFIC VALUE:
- Meteorites provide material from outer space for scientific study
- Some contain organic compounds or minerals not found on Earth
